embedder.basis: read from the VectorBackend that indexed each case, not from a command-line label
embedder.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2

exclusions.rule: none -- every cell attempted is scored; a killed or crashed case is scored as a MISS and counted, never dropped

seeds.case_order: the matrix order in tests/test_niah.py::_TEST_PARAMS, then sorted by unit_id before writing
seeds.rng: none -- filler haystack content is derived deterministically from the block index via sha256 (tests/test_niah.py::_deterministic_hash)

run.isolation: one hard-killed child process per case (SIGKILL on the process group)

sampling: SMOKE SUBSET: 7 of 250 cells (stride 37, limit none) -- NOT the published 250/250 figure
